round_doc:
Round a number to a given precision in decimal digits.

The return value is an integer if ndigits is omitted or None.
Otherwise the return value has the same type as the number.  ndigits
may be negative.

interpretive_findings.finding: Original problem specifies four decimal places, not four significant digits and not an explicit tie-breaking rule.
Both exporter versions use Python float round(x,4) plus 0.0000; ties-to-even differs from decimal half-up at exact midpoints, and binary conversion can move an apparent decimal midpoint.

Q3 57.4723 h is the correct nearest-rounded critical-time approximation, but its exact literal time precedes the recorded downward crossing by 0.007022017583949491 s; not a certified strictly feasible execution time. No saved exact state at that literal time was available or fabricated.

57.4724 h Q3 and 51.0906 h Q4 are the declared four-decimal grid times with original unrounded all-node strict-feasibility certificates. Displayed maximum concentration 0.1500 does not replace original precision in the inequality.

The strict continuous feasible set has an open onset under continuous strict crossing; the critical time is its infimum. A minimum exists for the discrete reporting grid under the tested conditions. ceil(event_s)+1 is a separate conservative integration endpoint.

Using 57.4723 h as an explicitly approximate critical-time label is mathematically defensible and compatible with four-decimal formatting; the problem does not explicitly mandate upward rounding. It cannot silently replace a 57.4724 h strict-report table label while retaining its computed values.

recommendation: 保留现有四位格式及正式数值：临界时长约57.4723 h；按0.0001 h网格报告并复核严格干燥条件，取57.4724 h。Q4两者均为51.0906 h。
